title: FundingBlock
description: Paper-level funding, replacing the single free-text funding_source. Funding has TWO provenances and only one of them can satisfy the locator contract: clinical.py:2483-2485 falls back to paper_metadata.funding_sources from API metadata, ', '.join-ed, which exists nowhere in the paper text. undisclosed (the paper is silent) is NOT unknown (we failed to extract) — Ep09's thesis makes that distinction the finding, so the two states are represented separately and rolled up separately. The oneOf below IS the legal-combination table; any combination outside it is a validation failure, not a warning.

funding_raw.description: Verbatim funder text as printed, when funding_source_type is extracted_text. When it is api_metadata this is whatever paper_metadata.funding_sources returned, ', '.join-ed — NOT a quotation from the paper. null when there is nothing to attribute.

funding_category.description: Normalised category, and the value every step-5 rollup counts. Multi-funder rule: any industry money alongside any non-industry money is 'mixed', and mixed is its own category — never double-counted into industry and government.

funding_disclosure.description: disclosed = the paper states its funding. undisclosed = the paper is silent. unknown = we failed to extract.

funding_source_type.description: Where the funding statement came from. 'none' means there is nothing to attribute, which is what makes the undisclosed and unknown states representable at all.

funding_locator.description: Required iff funding_source_type is extracted_text; null otherwise. Its fields list must name funding_raw.

oneOf.title: disclosed, quoted from the paper text
disclosed, but only via API metadata — no locator, cannot be verified against the paper
the paper is silent about funding — a finding, not a gap
extraction failed — we do not know what the paper says
